In this video, I explore Rwanda
The African country once destroyed by genocide, but today known as one of the cleanest, safest and most disciplined nations in Africa.
From the dark history of the 1994 Rwanda Genocide to the modern streets of Kigali, this vlog-style documentary covers Rwanda’s unbelievable transformation over the last 30 years.
I visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial, local markets, modern infrastructure, Kigali Convention Centre, spotless roads and much more while explaining how Rwanda is now being compared to Singapore, Dubai and Hong Kong.
